items.title: Bell Canada says 'agentic' hacker stole enterprise customer data
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>Bell Canada has confirmed that an "agentic" threat actor breached its systems on November 17, 2026, and stole enterprise customer data, including information from a system used to order and provision telecommunications circuits. [...]</article>

items.title: Hackers use autonomous AI tool Cairn to find zero-day, take over server
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>Threat actors used the open-source AI penetration-testing framework Cairn to find a previously unknown vulnerability in a medical imaging application. [...]</article>

items.title: Vendor data breach exposes Chase, Visa, Mastercard customer info
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>J.P. Morgan Chase warned it suffered a data breach after a cyberattack at a third-party service provider exposed customers' personal information and marketing data. [...]</article>

items.title: Still tracking company passwords in spreadsheets? You’re flying blind.
items.author: Sponsored by NordPass Business
items.content: <article>Tracking company passwords in spreadsheets can leave IT administrators unaware of weak, reused, or compromised credentials stored and shared outside approved systems. NordPass explains how centralized password management can improve credential visibility, identify security risks, and simplify secure password sharing. [...]</article>

items.title: N-able says recent security breach led to major service outage
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>N-able says attackers who breached one of its servers have caused a major outage affecting Mail Assure and SpamExperts Hosted Cloud services worldwide. [...]</article>

items.title: Microsoft now automatically installs Windows 11 26H2 on unmanaged devices
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Starting this week, Microsoft has begun automatically upgrading eligible devices that aren't managed by an IT department to Windows 11 26H2. [...]</article>

items.title: F5 releases emergency patches for critical BIG-IP RCE flaws
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>US cybersecurity company F5 warned customers to patch five critical BIG-IP vulnerabilities that attackers can exploit to trigger denial-of-service (DoS) or gain remote code execution. [...]</article>

items.title: Windows 11 KB5132057 update released with 28 changes and fixes
items.author: Sergiu Gatlan
items.content: <article>Microsoft released the KB5132057 November Windows 11 preview update, which comes with 28 changes, including improvements to Windows Search, Windows Hello, and the Run dialog. [...]</article>

items.title: VMware patches vCenter zero-day exploited in attacks since September
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>Broadcom has released security updates to fix a critical VMware vCenter Server authentication bypass vulnerability that Chinese-linked hackers have exploited in zero-day attacks since September 2026. [...]</article>

items.title: Hackers steal data of 1.6 million SBC Medical Group customers
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>SBC Medical Group has warned in a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) that two cybersecurity incidents exposed sensitive customer and employee information, including personal data belonging to 1.6 million people. [...]</article>

items.title: ASUS warns of critical hard-coded key flaw in Control Center Express
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>ASUS released Control Center Express v1.7.29 to fix three critical vulnerabilities that could let remote attackers gain administrative control of the management console and the devices it manages. [...]</article>

items.title: Transport for London breach exposes 265,000 Oyster card users' data
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>Transport for London (TfL) has announced that around 265,000 Oyster photocard customers may have had their account details exposed in a data breach. [...]</article>

items.title: PHP security updates fix 18 flaws, including critical RCE bugs
items.author: Lawrence Abrams
items.content: <article>The PHP development team released security updates addressing 18 vulnerabilities, including critical flaws that could allow unauthenticated attackers to remotely execute code on vulnerable servers. [...]</article>

items.title: Five warning signs of ransomware breach before encryption or data theft
items.author: Sponsored by Acronis
items.content: <article>Ransomware attacks often involve credential theft, lateral movement, and attempts to disable security controls long before encryption begins. Acronis examines five warning signs that can help defenders detect intrusions earlier, contain malicious activity, and protect critical systems and backups. [...]</article>

items.title: Critical NGINX ‘NGINX2Root’ bugs let attackers hijack servers
items.author: Bill Toulas
items.content: <article>Two critical NGINX vulnerabilities dubbed "nginx2root" allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code remotely on vulnerable web servers, with researchers demonstrating how the flaws can be chained with a Linux kernel bug to gain root access. [...]</article>
